reviews.text:
The vets were very attentive and caring towards our cat. We received excellent advice, and our indoor cat is now losing weight without being frustrated.

We consulted several vets before finally finding the right one.

The clinic is clean and pleasant, and the staff is friendly and welcoming.

We are very satisfied and highly recommend this clinic.

Since the excellent recovery and care our little Gaia, a 15-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, received following her pancreatitis, we returned to the clinic yesterday for a check-up and vaccinations with Dr. Toggenburger. He was as available, professional, and kind as ever to both the patient and the parents!

A big thank you to the entire team!
Perfect, you can trust it completely!
Pleasant welcome, attentive veterinarian who provided all the necessary explanations. Highly recommended.

After an operation performed by Dr. Dos Santos, my dog ​​was weak when I got home, but by the evening he had regained his strength. Everything went exactly as the veterinarian had predicted.

I highly recommend this practice, where the staff is warm and reassuring. Dr. Dos Santos was very attentive. He showed great empathy and operated on my dog ​​with great professionalism.

I thank him sincerely.
I recommend the team of Parisian vets.

We arrived without an appointment for a minor ear problem, and the staff took care of us immediately. The welcome was very pleasant, and the vet was excellent.
Thank you so much!
Junior left very happy.

This vet clinic deserves 1,000,000 stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟 This morning with the help of Christophe we were able to reunite a beautiful dog with its equally beautiful owner. I recovered the dog by pure luck on Saturday evening and brought him to Christophe and his team yesterday as he was injured. We found his family who were overjoyed❤️😭 Christophe and his team took such amazing care of Léon and helped him with his injuries. I myself have a nearly 14 year old dog and we have been with him for years so I know that Christophe and all the other vets - Fiona, Arielle, Florine and Lucille are as passionate about animals as much as I am. For them its, animal first always🌟❤️🙏🐕 I can't thank Christophe and all the girls there for helping me reunite this little guy with his family. This is hands down the best vet's in the world❤️🙏🐕🌟✨️
I needed to get the tape worm treatment before travelling back to the UK - the vets were brilliant and managed to help me with this very easily - thank you so much :)

The welcome, the work, everything was perfect.

It's an excellent team.

The prices are quite high, but that's the same everywhere.
A warm and professional welcome. Thank you for listening and for the advice.
Appointment for annual check-up. Brand new practice, caring and professional veterinarian.

The employees and vet here were so extremely helpful and kind! We were in a very last-minute situation, and they went above and beyond to squeeze us in and make sure we had everything we needed for my cat and dog, Anakin and Charlie. Everyone was so patient, accommodating, and genuinely wonderful throughout the entire process. They were truly the absolute best, and I’m so incredibly grateful for all of their help!! I cannot recommend them enough!

A wonderful encounter, pleasant conversations, and great advice!
Thank you

I highly recommend Les Vétos Parisiens! The whole team was wonderful with my kitten. They took the time to put him at ease, so much so that he wasn't even scared of his vaccination. You can tell they truly love animals and care for them with great gentleness and kindness.

The welcome is warm, the explanations are clear, and you immediately feel confident. It's reassuring to know your pet is in such good hands. A big thank you to the whole team!
A caring and patient team.

I had no doubt about coming to see you. My Cavalier King Charles Spaniel is in good hands. I absolutely loved my interaction with Dr. Dos Santos; he was very observant, very clear in his explanations, and wonderful with my sensitive rider who doesn't like being handled. Thank you 🙏

We went to the new Parisian vet clinic and, as expected, it was exactly what we hoped for!

The same warm, professional, and dedicated welcome for our pets!
It felt just like the old Rue de la Pompe clinic – a real pleasure!
Service au top !
Very good, very friendly and welcoming team, good advice. My dog ​​loves being there.

Thank you to Dr. Dos Santos and his entire team—a caring, attentive, efficient, and professional team who love animals. They saved my 15-year-old dog. I was at an emergency veterinary clinic the night before when I encountered some thieves, and Dr. Dos Santos' team restored my faith in veterinarians. The only problem is that once you've dealt with them, you can't do without them because you trust no one else.
The vet was speaking english, they also helped me to do the vaccines and assisted with docs related to importing our dog from another country.
What a wonderful veterinary experience. The vet was great, patient, and took excellent care of my little puppy. I’ll definitely make them my go-to vet in Paris.
Excellent practice! Super clean and with staff who are extremely attentive to the animal during consultations. Even after the appointment. I've never seen anything like it. Thank you so much.
Everything went very well. The vets were very attentive. I highly recommend them ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

So happy I found Les Vetos. They are kind,  take the time to listen to you and talk you through options. The clinic is clean, modern and well equipped. Our dog is  a gentle giant but a little nervous since he had some negative experiences when he was younger and they are patient and gentle with him. I changed from another vet in the area who had the total opposite approach and were rushed and rude - so glad I made the switched. 10/10.
They're great!

Everything was perfect at the Suffren clinic.
Thank you again!

An absolutely perfect consultation! My cat was impressively calm, something I've never seen him do when handled by anyone else. Everything went very smoothly, quickly, and without the slightest complication. A huge thank you to the entire veterinary team for their remarkable kindness and professionalism. I highly recommend them! Rose and Kay are truly grateful!
If it hadn't been for you, I don't know if Papouillette would still be alive, so THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU. I can't thank you enough for what you did for him.
Thank you to the whole team. So glad I found you.
Thank you to Dr. CIUP for taking care of my dog. A good diagnosis, excellent treatment, and above all, always available. Thank you ♥️

An exceptionally skilled veterinarian 🐾
She has cared for my dog ​​since birth with remarkable professionalism, great precision, and unwavering attention.
Her expertise and dedication inspire complete confidence. Thank you so much! 🐶💙

The welcome and professionalism were excellent.

Thank you so much for your kindness.
As always, we received a very warm welcome and were reassured at the Parisian Vetos! Thank you so much ☺️
Excellent vet, I highly recommend him!

Always so welcoming, a very friendly and attentive team.
My dog ​​is very happy; she loves her vet.

My dog ​​usually hates going to the vet, but he loved meeting his new vet at Clinique Les Vétos Parisiens!
The vet really took the time to put him at ease and examined him calmly. As a result, Rex was completely at ease. A very good experience for both of us. 🐶✨ …

Excellent vet.

I consulted several vets for my 13-year-old cat, Wendy, and I finally found the right one 👍🏼
Dr. Dos Santos is very caring and listens to both the animal 🐶 and the owner.

I highly recommend him.
Thank you 🫶🏽

Excellent practice that cared for my cat until the very end in the best possible conditions. I highly recommend this place; the grieving process was certainly made easier by the way you welcomed and supported me during this very difficult time. Thank you.
The vet who treated our cat twice was perfect with her, and everything went very well.
Perfect, as usual. I recommend this veterinary clinic. The welcome is excellent, and dogs and cats are treated with gentleness and understanding.

Very pleasant practice. The receptionist and veterinarian were very attentive.

I recommend it.

I recommend this clinic 1000%!

The clinic is clean and modern with state-of-the-art equipment. Furthermore, Dr. Ciup is attentive and readily available. She has successfully treated my little dog on several occasions despite his multiple health issues.

Oscar has been followed by Dr. Ciup and Dr. Dos Santos since he was a puppy, and to my great delight, they've opened a new clinic just a stone's throw from my home in the 7th arrondissement! So, naturally, I'm continuing Oscar's care with my favorite vets.
Thank you for EVERYTHING you do for him, you're the best!
